brief:
Israel is threatening to shut down the Qalandiya Training Centre, one of Jerusalem's oldest operational educational institutions and UNRWA's only vocational college in East Jerusalem, according to Al Jazeera English. The facility has served Palestinians across the region for decades, offering job training in technical and professional fields that remain scarce in the territory.

The threatened closure would eliminate a rare specialized educational resource at a time when Palestinian unemployment remains high. The centre has trained thousands of students over its years of operation, many of whom went on to secure employment in construction, mechanics, hospitality, and other trades. Loss of the facility would leave the Palestinian population without an established alternative for vocational preparation.
dek: Israel threatens the Qalandiya Training Centre, one of Jerusalem's oldest still-operational educational institutions.
title: Israel threatens closure of UNRWA's sole vocational college in East Jerusalem
